title: Sell Mineral Rights in Tuscarawas, OH
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Tuscarawas, OH | Village vs County
metaDescription: The village of Tuscarawas sits inside Tuscarawas County. See how to sort out which one applies to your deed and how to sell your mineral interest.
heroLead: There is a village called Tuscarawas sitting inside Tuscarawas County, and sorting out which one your deed actually refers to is sometimes the first small hurdle in figuring out what you own.
intro: The village of Tuscarawas is a small community along the Tuscarawas River, itself inside the county of the same name, on the western flank of the Utica/Point Pleasant play. It is genuinely common for owners to see the county name on a deed or tax document and assume it refers to the village, or vice versa, especially on older paperwork.

Whichever it turns out to be, the underlying process is the same: confirm the legal description, trace ownership through the county recorder's records, and check current activity for that specific township.

sections.heading: Sorting out village versus county on your deed
paragraphs: A legal description will specify the actual section, township, and range, or reference a specific plat, which tells us definitively whether your interest sits within the village limits or elsewhere in the broader county.

This distinction rarely changes much about the process itself, since both are governed by the same Tuscarawas County Recorder's office in New Philadelphia, but it does help us identify the correct parcel and nearby activity.

sections.heading: What activity near the village looks like
paragraphs: Flank-position acreage in this part of the county has seen permitting activity in some townships and little to none in others. We check Ohio Department of Natural Resources records for the specific section tied to your interest rather than assuming based on the general area.
If your interest sits in a township with active or pooled units nearby, that materially changes the offer compared with acreage with no nearby activity.

sections.heading: Confirming ownership and moving to an offer
paragraphs: Once we have confirmed the exact parcel and traced ownership through any inheritance or prior sales, we put together a written offer reflecting your documented percentage and current conditions.
You are welcome to have an attorney review the prepared deed before signing, and there is no obligation to accept.

faqs.question: How do I know if my deed refers to the village of Tuscarawas or the county generally?
faqs.answer: The legal description, section, township, and range, or plat reference, tells us definitively. We review this as part of the title search.

faqs.question: Does it matter which one my interest is actually in?
faqs.answer: Not for the overall process, since both fall under the same county recorder's office, but it does affect which specific activity data applies to your parcel.

faqs.question: Is there active drilling near the village of Tuscarawas?
faqs.answer: It varies by township within the flank position of the county. We check current state records for your specific section before quoting.
